evidence.title: Inertial Manifold Neural Operator for Dissipative Time-Dependent Partial Differential Equations

summary: Researchers have introduced an Inertial Manifold Neural Operator that leverages manifold reduction to efficiently approximate solutions of dissipative, time‑dependent partial differential equations. The method dramatically cuts computational cost while preserving high accuracy, offering a powerful tool for scientific computing.
title: New Inertial Manifold Neural Operator Accelerates Solving Dissipative Time‑Dependent PDEs
